items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: At that time he was still married to Ava Gardner and so the band was augmented with Italian musicians... Ava Gardner was advertised to appear at the theater

ctx.x: Okay, you went to North Africa and you were contracted to do what?

We were contracted to join Frank Sinatra on his tour of the principal cities in Italy, like Rome and Naples. At that time he was still married to Ava Gardner and so the band was augmented with Italian musicians who didn't speak a word of English and none of us could speak a word of Italian. So we had interpreters with the group and of course Frank paid for everything, you know.
